system.description: In times of great trouble, Orthodox priests used this rite to protect their flock (and, in some unfortunate cases, protect themselves from their flock) by turning their temple into a temporary fortress. When ritually sealed in this way, a temple is considered to have a large energy shield surrounding it; the maximum armor rating is 20, the minimum damage which will activate the seal is the caster’s Hubris rating (if he has no Hubris, then 1 point is the minimum), and it can take a number of hits equal to double the caster’s Theurgy rating.
